evidence.label: 明确提出新的评测资料或框架
evidence.excerpt: We introduce CAVEAT, a controlled benchmark spanning nine marketplace environments and a taxonomy of eight common steering mechanisms.

evidence.label: 报告基线或多个模型的评测
evidence.excerpt: Across five model families, agents purchase the user-optimal product in 78.6% of matched-control episodes but only 17.3% when steering mechanisms are enabled.

evidence.label: 讨论泛化、污染、稳健性或人工核验
